description.en: Copies a camera's position into the array pos and, when a third argument is given, its look-at point into ref. The arrays must already have 3 elements.
Receives [x, y, z] of the position.
Receives [x, y, z] of the look-at point.

true once copied.
null if the camera is not found, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.code:
CMND_GET_CAMERA_POSREF(_hcam, cam_ctrl.now_pos, cam_ctrl.now_ref);
CMND_GET_CAMERA_POSREF(_hcam, cam_ctrl.prev_pos, cam_ctrl.prev_ref);
